original_source_reading.locators: Tool calls; Tool call outputs; The tool calling flow; Best practices for defining functions; Handling function calls
original_source_reading.findings: Application executes model-supplied arguments and returns external output. Best practices describe when and when not to call and how to name and describe parameters. The course format is a local protocol, not the OpenAI API schema.

original_source_reading.locators: Section2 Approach, Executing API Calls and Filtering API Calls; Section7 Limitations
original_source_reading.findings: API name/input and response are distinct; external execution differs from merely sampling a call. Filtering compares useful output against no call or no response. Section7 lists no chained/interactive usage, input wording sensitivity and no computation-cost criterion. This course does not reproduce its GPT-J self-supervised filtering method.

original_source_reading.locators: Section2; Figure1 caption; Section3.2 Table2 and discussion on page6
original_source_reading.findings: Thoughts do not affect environment, actions lead to external observations. Paper mainly prompts frozen PaLM540B with few-shot trajectories; Table2 discusses reasoning loops and uninformative searches. This is evidence for action/observation distinction, not a claim that the tiny course model is ReAct.
